# Welcome {.unnumbered}

**Anyone Can Network** is about the network you already have. The router in the closet, the Wi-Fi that drops in the bedroom, the smart plug that phones home at 3 a.m. By the end you'll know how all of it works and how to fix it when it doesn't.

Your own home is the lab. No special equipment required, though you may find yourself wanting some.

::: {.callout-important}
## Early draft
This book is being written in the open, and most chapters are still outlines. Follow along, or jump in and help.
:::

## How this book works

The first chapter follows a single web request on its whole journey. Every chapter after that zooms in on one stop along the way.

::: {.callout-note}
## Concept box
Connects what you're learning to things you see every day.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
A safe way to break part of your network and fix it. This is how you learn to troubleshoot.
:::
